My friend Kirsty and I have just returned from an amazing 8-day Golden Triangle tour of India, and from start to finish the entire experience was absolutely fantastic.

We travelled through Delhi, Agra and Jaipur, and also went on safari, which was one of the highlights of the trip. We were incredibly lucky to see tigers, which made the experience even more unforgettable.

A very special mention has to go to our driver, Mr Ram Kumar, who was outstanding throughout the whole tour. He was so hospitable, friendly, professional and accommodating to all of our needs. Nothing was ever too much trouble for him. He kept us informed every step of the way, answered all of our endless questions, and made us feel safe, comfortable and relaxed throughout the journey.

We also really appreciated the thoughtful touches, such as having water provided at every stop, which was especially welcome in the heat and showed how well organised the tour was.

Every local guide we had was brilliant – so knowledgeable, informative and passionate about the places we visited. We learned so much about all the temples, landmarks and history in each area, which made the tour even more special.

All of the hotels we stayed in were excellent, each with their own unique charm and character, which added something special to the whole experience. Having breakfast included each morning was also a lovely bonus and made everything even easier and more enjoyable.

Overall, this was an incredibly well-organised, stress-free and memorable trip. We had the most wonderful time and would highly recommend this tour company to anyone thinking of booking a tour of India.

Don’t delay – book it! You won’t regret it.

Thank you for such an unforgettable experience.

– Iola & Kirsty

I just finished my five day tour of the Golden Triangle along with a Tiger safari which I booked through Viator.  The local tour company was Julie International Tours and the whole outfit was excellent from my daily point of contact via WhatsApp, Ms Sonia Handa.  Sonia was always on point with daily updates, advising me of my driver information and was quick to respond if I had any questions.  Sonia also provided great tips on scams to look out for which was very much appreciated.  My driver Ram Pal was excellent.  He arrived every morning at the time he said he would, responded immediately to my texts if I had any questions regarding the following day and provided information about the destinations to which we were proceeding.  My three guides, Jitendra, Sanjay and Rajesh were superb.  They really know their information and they were all very easy to understand and quite personable - very willing to discuss cultural differences I asked about.  They were also great at providing me insight on some of the political circumstances since 1947 and Indian independence.  I appreciated learning that the Western historical view and movie portrayals may not necessarily be as accurate as the reality.  These conversations brought the engagement between us to a more human level rather than simply the tourist/guide exchange.  It is incredible how smoothly all the logistics worked out each day.  All of my 5-star accommodations were top notch.  And bonus, I managed to see two tigers on safari.  I give this tour and this team five out of five stars.

We took a slightly abbreviated Golden Triangle tour where we did Jaipur and Agra but not Delhi.

Ms. Sonia Handa of Joyful Holidays customized the tour to our needs.  She clearly outlined the itinerary and always provided detailed information when we requested it and answered all our questions and concerns promptly.  She was easily accessible whenever we needed her help.

We chose to stay in 4 star hotels and were pleasantly surprised by how spacious and clean these hotels were. The hotels staff and service were exceptional and buffet breakfasts were included with the hotel stay.

Our driver, Mr Shiv Kumar, was excellent. We could never have made our way around India without him. He was courteous, kind and safely got us where we needed to be on time.

The tour guides were all very knowledgeable, polite, and presented the information well.  They do take you into local artisan shops to demonstrate their crafts and do want you to purchase their goods. It was interesting but I preferred to see more of the sights.

It was a wonderful experience and I would definitely recommend joyful holidays as they made the experience a memorable one.
